description:
Hushfacebook v0.1.8 targets Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 (com.facebook.katana), and 577.0.0.50.72 still works.

Clean up Reels now takes the Follow button off reels on the Reels tab. In 0.1.7 it only caught the Following button next to people you already follow.

There are 22 patches in all. Sponsored and suggested posts leave the news feed without a gap, and ads are gone from Stories and Reels. Facebook stops downloading ads in the background and sending ad telemetry. Links open in your browser and media can be saved. There's an AMOLED black theme and a Material You one.

Validation: 471 runtime tests passed locally. All 171 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lint checks. All 22 patches applied to Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72 with no manifest changes.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 from APKMirror. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
